paragraphs.text: Alela is a faerie warlock from Eldraine .

Alela is known to be an uncommonly patient faerie warlock, favoring grand schemes over petty mischief. She believes Rankle ’s pranks are but child’s play, while her games will be enough to topple kingdoms.
Alela survived the New Phyrexian Invasion .

Alela would go on to align herself with Tegwyll , Duke of Splendor, who schemed for power over the high fae court and knew Alela had droves of mischievous faeries that served her. She was instrumental in his coming-of-age announcement ceremony, where Alela's gang of faeries set upon the high fae, he could not persuade in-secret with cruel pranks that sullied their reputation.
